description: Every tool POST /mcp offers. Written by scripts/mcp_json.sh from the registered tools; do not edit by hand. A key sees the tools its role allows (adminOnly ones need an admin key), and a tool whose feature is switched off answers like one that does not exist. route is the HTTP route the tool stands for, with the same rules; http_only are the routes a key may call that have no tool, and why.

http_only.reason: A file download (JSON, CSV or Markdown attachment); search_library, get_title and the list tools return the same records as JSON.
Poster image bytes, not JSON: an agent fetches them here with the same key.
The MCP reference itself; tools/list gives the same list.
The API reference itself; GET /api/mcp.json is the MCP one.
Sign-in: managed from a browser, not by agents.
Sign-in: managed from a browser, not by agents.
Ends a browser session; a key has none to end.
The browser's own activity reports (track.js), not an action.

tools.description: The account this API key belongs to, the role it acts with (role -- never higher than the key's own scope), and the account's own role.
tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I

tools.description: People with an active account, a page at a time: id and display name. Use the id wherever another tool asks for a user. next is the offset of the following page, or null on the last one.

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next value of the previous page.

tools.name: list_team
tools.title: List team

tools.description: Accounts, a page at a time, including disabled ones, with each one's role and which is the owner. next is the offset of the following page, or null on the last one.

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next value of the previous page.

tools.name: admin_list_users
tools.title: List users (admin)

tools.description: Switch an account off (disabled: true) or back on (false). Disabling signs it out everywhere and voids its live login link; its API keys stop working while it is off. Reversible. The owner and your own account cannot be disabled.

user_id.description: The account's id, from list_team or admin_list_users.

tools.name: admin_set_user_disabled
tools.title: Disable or enable a user (admin)

tools.description: For an account that may be compromised: ends every session and voids its live login link and every API key it holds, at once. The account stays enabled; someone with a browser session must issue a new login link to let its owner back in. The owner and your own account cannot be revoked.

user_id.description: The account's id, from list_team or admin_list_users.

tools.name: admin_revoke_access
tools.title: Revoke a user's access (admin)

tools.description: Change your own display name (1-80 characters). expect, when given, is the name you think it has now; if someone changed it meanwhile the rename is refused with the current name, so nothing is overwritten unseen.

expect.description: The current name, from whoami. Optional.

tools.name: rename_account
tools.title: Rename your account

tools.description: Replace your whole list of color themes (1 to 40) and pick the one you use. themes: null goes back to following the app's defaults. A theme is the Theme schema in the API reference (config/openapi.json): id, name, mode light|dark, accent, second, and optional colors as #rrggbb. whoami shows the current list.
tools.name: set_themes
tools.title: Replace your own themes

tools.description: Switch to another theme from your list (or the defaults), by its id.
tools.name: set_theme
tools.title: Pick your theme

tools.description: The theme list everyone without their own list sees. themes is null while the built-in ones apply.
tools.name: admin_get_theme_defaults
tools.title: Default themes (admin)

tools.description: Replace the theme list everyone without their own list sees, 1 to 40 themes in the Theme schema of the API reference. null puts the built-in themes back.
tools.name: admin_set_theme_defaults
tools.title: Replace the default themes (admin)

tools.description: Group invite links, a page at a time: label, places used and left, expiry, and whether each still works. The links themselves are never shown again after creation. next is the offset of the following page, or null on the last one.

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next value of the previous page.

tools.name: admin_list_invite_links
tools.title: List invite links (admin)

tools.description: Stop an invite link from letting anyone else join or sign in through it. Accounts it already made keep working. Cannot be switched back on.
tools.name: admin_revoke_invite_link
tools.title: Switch off an invite link (admin)

tools.description: Titles in the family library, with your own state on each (status, rating, heart) and who else has watched or loved it. All arguments optional: text matches title, director, cast, genres, tags and notes; status is queue, watching, watched, dropped or none, or up_next for the Up next list (queue and watching, newest first).

type.description: A type id such as movie or tv.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: search_library
tools.title: Search the library

tools.description: The fixed words: statuses, lookup kinds, and the canonical genre names.
tools.name: get_vocab
tools.title: Library vocabulary

tools.description: Everything about one title, your state on it and the family's.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: get_title
tools.title: Get a title

tools.description: Add a title to the family library and put it on a list (status: queue by default, or watched, watching, dropped, none). Refuses with possible duplicates unless force is true. Details are filled in in the background.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: add_title
tools.title: Add a title

tools.description: Would adding this title make a duplicate? The library titles it resembles, with a score. Writes nothing.
tools.name: check_title
tools.title: Check for a duplicate

tools.description: One change to many titles at once. op: set_type (value: a type id), add_tags or remove_tags (value: a list of tags), delete, restore, or set_fields (value: {title id: fields}, the undo). Returns each title's previous values -- send them back with set_fields to undo. Deletes are soft and restorable.
tools.name: bulk_edit_titles
tools.title: Change many titles

tools.description: Change shared details of a title (title, year, type, tags, notes, links, genres, cast, creator, runtime, certification, imdb_id, wiki_url, poster_url). Returns the previous values.

expect.description: Optional: the value you think it has now (the rev from your last read); if it changed meanwhile the call is refused with the current one.

tools.name: update_title
tools.title: Edit a title

tools.description: Take a title out of the library for everyone. Soft: restore_title brings it back within the undo window.
tools.name: delete_title
tools.title: Delete a title

tools.description: Bring back a deleted title, within the undo window.
tools.name: restore_title
tools.title: Restore a title

tools.description: Look the title up with the configured providers now and fill in missing details (refresh: true overwrites what is there). Returns the previous values.
tools.name: enrich_title
tools.title: Fill a title in

tools.description: Keep title_id and fold the drop_ids into it: everyone's state, playlists and details move over and the others are deleted. One undo step: undo_merge with the merge_id returned.
tools.name: merge_titles
tools.title: Merge duplicates

tools.description: Groups of library titles that look like the same work, minus pairs marked as different.
tools.name: list_duplicates
tools.title: Possible duplicates

tools.description: Mark two or more titles as not the same, for the whole family. Returns the pairs, which undismiss_duplicates takes back.
tools.name: dismiss_duplicates
tools.title: Not duplicates

tools.description: Forget pairs dismiss_duplicates recorded.
tools.name: undismiss_duplicates
tools.title: Undo not duplicates

tools.description: Put a merge back as it was: the dropped titles, and everyone's state and playlists.
tools.name: undo_merge
tools.title: Undo a merge

tools.description: Change one person's state on a title: status (queue, watching, watched, dropped, or null for off the list), rating 1-10 or null, heart true/false, note, watched_at. Returns the previous values.

expect.description: Optional: the value you think it has now (the rev from your last read); if it changed meanwhile the call is refused with the current one.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: set_state
tools.title: Set status, rating or heart

tools.description: changes is {title id: {status, rating, heart, note, watched_at}}, up to 2000 titles. Returns each title's previous values, which sent back are the undo.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: set_states
tools.title: Set state on many titles

tools.description: Identify a name, name and year, or link (IMDb, Wikipedia, TMDB, TVmaze...) with the configured providers, and say whether the library already has it. Writes nothing. Counts against the same per-person lookup allowance as the Add screen.
tools.name: lookup
tools.title: Look a title up

tools.description: Read a pasted list or file's text (format auto, outline, csv or json) into rows of title fields, each with its likeliest duplicate. Writes nothing: send the rows you want to import_items.
tools.name: import_parse
tools.title: Read an import

tools.description: Create titles from rows ({fields, state}, at most 200 per call), skipping any the library certainly has unless skip_dupes is false, and put them on the person's lists. Send the same batch_id for every call of one import; undo_import takes the whole batch back.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: import_items
tools.title: Import titles

tools.description: Delete the titles one import created, and the importer's state on them.
tools.name: undo_import
tools.title: Undo an import

tools.description: The Wikipedia film catalogue, minus films you skipped. genres is comma-separated; sort is notable, imdb, year, year-asc or title. Each film says whether it is already in the library (title_id) and your status on it.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: discover_search
tools.title: Search Discover

tools.description: What the Discover catalogue holds: its source lists and topics, coverage, and rating counts.
tools.name: discover_meta
tools.title: Discover catalogue

tools.description: Plot, cast and poster for up to 60 catalogue films, by Wikipedia article name (the film's url ends in it).
tools.name: discover_facts
tools.title: Discover film details

tools.description: verdict: skip (hide it from you), seen, or leave it out to clear.

expect.description: Optional: the value you think it has now (the rev from your last read); if it changed meanwhile the call is refused with the current one.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: set_verdict
tools.title: Skip a Discover film

tools.description: Add a film from discover_search (pass the film object as returned) to the library, with its Wikipedia details. status: watched for Seen it, or leave out for no list. Refuses with possible duplicates unless force is true.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: discover_add
tools.title: Add a Discover film

tools.description: What the server is doing in the background (filling in titles, IMDb ratings, the catalogue), the poster cache, and whether lookups are on.
tools.name: jobs_status
tools.title: Background jobs

tools.description: Start a background job by its name from jobs_status (one marked manual). options are the job's own settings. Each job can make thousands of outbound calls.
tools.name: admin_start_job
tools.title: Start a job (admin)

tools.description: Ask a running background job to stop.
tools.name: admin_stop_job
tools.title: Stop a job (admin)

tools.description: A person's playlists: id, name and how many titles each holds. With playlist_id, that one playlist's titles instead, numbered in its order.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: list_playlists
tools.title: Playlists

tools.description: A new playlist, optionally with titles (items: title ids, in order).

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: create_playlist
tools.title: Create a playlist

tools.description: Put the playlists in this order (ids: every playlist id, first to last).

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: reorder_playlists
tools.title: Order playlists

tools.description: Give a playlist a new name. Returns the previous one.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: rename_playlist
tools.title: Rename a playlist

tools.description: Delete a playlist. Soft: restore_playlist brings it back within the undo window.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: delete_playlist
tools.title: Delete a playlist

tools.description: Bring back a deleted playlist, within the undo window.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: restore_playlist
tools.title: Restore a playlist

tools.description: Add titles at position (the end by default); the rest renumber. Returns the items before, which set_playlist_items takes back.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: add_to_playlist
tools.title: Add to a playlist

tools.description: Take titles off a playlist; the rest renumber. Returns the items before, which set_playlist_items takes back.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: remove_from_playlist
tools.title: Remove from a playlist

tools.description: Move one title to position; the rest renumber. Returns the items before, which set_playlist_items takes back.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: move_in_playlist
tools.title: Move within a playlist

tools.description: Replace a playlist's titles with items, in order -- the undo of add, remove and move. Returns the items before.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: set_playlist_items
tools.title: Set a playlist's titles

tools.description: A person's saved views: a named query on the library or Discover screen, in their order.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: list_views
tools.title: Saved views

tools.description: Save a named view of a screen.

card.description: How cards look in this view.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: create_view
tools.title: Save a view

tools.description: Put the saved views in this order (ids: view ids, first to last).

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: reorder_views
tools.title: Order views

tools.description: Change a saved view's name, query, card layout or icon. Returns the previous values.

card.description: How cards look in this view.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: update_view
tools.title: Change a view

tools.description: Delete a saved view. Soft: restore_view brings it back within the undo window.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: delete_view
tools.title: Delete a view

tools.description: Bring back a deleted saved view, within the undo window.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: restore_view
tools.title: Restore a view

tools.description: A person's settings that follow them between devices: cards (layout per screen), last_query, default_view and ui.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: get_prefs
tools.title: Settings

tools.description: Change settings by section (cards, last_query, default_view, ui): each key given replaces that key within its section, and null removes it. Returns them all.

user_id.description: Whose state (an admin's key, or one given Showing); defaults to the key's own account.

tools.name: save_prefs
tools.title: Change settings

tools.description: The library's sections (Movies, TV, and any the family added), in order.
tools.name: list_types
tools.title: Media types

tools.description: Create a media type, or change one by its id. Movies and TV keep their lookup.

id.description: a-z, 0-9 and -; never changes once made.

lookup.description: What titles of this type are looked up as: movie, tv, book, ... or other.

tools.name: save_type
tools.title: Add or change a type

tools.description: Delete a media type. One that still holds titles needs reassign_to, the type they move to. Movies and TV cannot be deleted. Soft: restore_type brings it back.
tools.name: delete_type

tools.description: Bring back a deleted media type, within the undo window.

tools.description: The lists and pages titles were found on, newest first.

tools.title: Sources

tools.description: Remember a list or page titles were found on.
tools.name: create_source
tools.title: Add a source

tools.description: Change a source's link, title, note or tags. Returns the previous values.

tools.title: Change a source

tools.description: Delete a source. Soft: restore_source brings it back within the undo window.
tools.name: delete_source
tools.title: Delete a source

tools.description: Bring back a deleted source, within the undo window.
tools.name: restore_source
tools.title: Restore a source

transport: Streamable HTTP, stateless: one JSON-RPC message per POST, a JSON reply
